title: Selected Sermons of George Whitefield
author: George Whitefield
tradition_notes: Whitefield was a Calvinist Methodist and leading figure of the Great Awakening. Unlike Wesley, he held to Calvinist soteriology (unconditional election, definite atonement).

supplementary_source.edition: The Works of the Reverend George Whitefield, Volume 6 (1771), Project Gutenberg #77041

notes: The primary CCEL witness supplies sermons 1-59. Sermons 60-61 ('Peter's Denial of his Lord'; 'The True Way of Beholding the Lamb of God') come from Project Gutenberg #77041, Works Volume 6 (1771), and are absent from the CCEL Selected Sermons witness. Whitefield died 1770, so both source texts are public domain. CCEL permission was confirmed 2026-04-01 (Quincy). CCEL osisRef values are empty; scripture references there are parsed from first-paragraph free text.
